purpose: Teach: 中絶/軍備/監理/邦人/略奪/強迫/クーデター/不起訴

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療的中絶の倫理について医療チームで研修します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team will be attending training on the ethics of medical abortion.
lines.style: Clear, direct opener. Steady professional tone. Even pacing. No rush. Delivering information as routine hospital business.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、戦時医療の軍備支援史を医療チームで参照しております
lines.en: Yes — we're referencing the history of wartime medicine and military support within the team.
lines.style: Measured acknowledgment. Slight pause before the explanation. Calm authority. Speaking as someone accustomed to explaining complex institutional decisions.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療機器の監理体制を、貴院、見直されたんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital has reviewed its medical equipment supervision protocols, then, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuine inquiry, respectfully framed. Slight uptick at the end—checking understanding rather than challenging. Thoughtful pace. The tone of someone learning and noting carefully.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、海外邦人の医療支援を医療チームで担当しております
lines.en: Yes — the medical team handles overseas support for Japanese nationals.
lines.style: Steady continuation. No emphasis. Speaking matter-of-factly about institutional responsibility. Breath is even, delivery unhurried.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医薬品略奪事件への対応を、貴院、なさったんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital responded to that pharmaceutical theft incident, then, Doctor?
lines.style: Softly perceptive question. Not accusatory—genuinely trying to piece together the institutional picture. Slight hesitation, as if weighing how to phrase it respectfully.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、強迫性障害の治療を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes — the medical team handles obsessive-compulsive disorder treatment.
lines.style: Calm restatement. Clinical precision. Same steady register. No inflection suggesting judgment. Speaking the fact as established protocol.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 海外クーデター時の邦人医療退避を、貴院、想定されてるそうですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital is already planning for medical evacuation of Japanese nationals during overseas coups, I understand, Doctor?
lines.style: Carefully constructed question. Respectful, almost gentle. Noticing something significant without pressing. Ren's trademark third-hour-conversation intelligence—connecting dots quietly.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療過誤の不起訴判断を医療チームで分析します
lines.en: Yes — the medical team analyzes medical malpractice decisions on non-prosecution.
lines.style: Close with slight fatigue underneath. Still professional. A breath heavier than before. The weariness of carrying institutional weight, delivered without complaint.
